note: Metrics only. No document text, no page images, no corpus or source file paths. Typographic-variant codepoints are NOT folded: raw CER is reported as measured.

algorithm.summary: Combined grc+deu+eng pass stays authoritative for orientation, geometry and reading order. Contiguous same-script line runs that are unambiguously Greek are re-recognized with grc alone and replace the combined text only if they pass containment, coverage, Greek/Latin retention, confidence and NFC checks. Any failure keeps the combined result.

real_corpus.description: Born-digital scholarly editions with embedded polytonic fonts; the publisher's own text layer is the ground truth. Identified bibliographically only.

german_and_mixed.source: Primavesi on Aristotle Metaph. A (de Gruyter), 5 pages

caveats: The public package is not the paper's 30-page test split; no comparison with its headline accuracy is made or implied.

Script labels (MainText_ColGreek/ColLatin) exist only on the 38 layout-only pages; every transcribed region is typed 'text'. Region script is therefore derived from the human transcription, never from OCR.
Every transcribed region is Greek, so CGPG can show the Greek improving but cannot show the Latin is unharmed; that evidence comes from the German and mixed pages.
Thresholds were tuned on dev only; holdout was scored once.

scanned_book_footnote_tokens.note: small-type umlauts are out of scope this round

ϕύσει.note: publisher uses U+03D5 PHI SYMBOL; OCR emits U+03C6

met: German running head not Hellenised on any page
German body umlaut/ss: no regression (9/97 both)
synthetic gold gate: pass, both candidates, no must-pass failures
CGPG holdout: script confusions 139 -> 0, CER 0.1494 -> 0.1357, no missing lines
CGPG holdout CER did not regress

missed.why: The residual sits in runs that are 60-80% Greek: mixed apparatus lines where the Latin count is itself partly an artifact of the corruption being measured. Lowering the ratio to reach them costs more on the German/mixed pages than it gains. Not closed by loosening a threshold.

Hard limit 0.0850 is met. Aggregate CER rises slightly against the combined baseline of 0.0721 because rerouting a Greek region costs a little on mixed pages while removing 81% of the script confusions. A ratio of 0.90 gave CER 0.0698 but missed the script-confusion rate target; the trade was resolved in favour of the stated primary objective.

end_to_end_pipeline.corpus: real scanned volume, 160 pages, no source text layer; not committed

unchanged_between_the_two.qpdf_check: no syntax or stream encoding errors

superseded_notice: The 2026-08-29 figures below were measured before the Latin-safety fixes and on a 16-page slice of the CGPG holdout. They are retained for traceability and are corrected by the 2026-08-30 entry.

correction_2026_08_30.summary: Greek script routing now defaults to OFF. The small-type Latin pass is a separate feature and defaults to ON.
why: The earlier Greek gain was partly taken from the Latin: German and mixed pages regressed CER 0.076471 -> 0.085930 and WER 0.202409 -> 0.219546.

With line-level geometric alignment, a reachable Latin-retention floor, and a gate that leaves confidently-read regions alone, those pages return to exactly the combined baseline (0.00% change) -- but the Greek benefit then largely disappears.
The 16-page CGPG holdout slice (139 -> 0 confusions) did not reproduce on the full 63-page holdout.

safety_fixes.latin_retention_reachable: ROUTING_SUBSTANTIAL_LATIN_CHARS = 8 now triggers retention, below the ROUTING_MAX_LATIN_CHARS = 40 routing ceiling. Previously the floor sat at the ceiling and could never fire.
safety_fixes.mixed_lines_preserved: Candidates are merged into the region by vertical alignment; a line with substantial Latin that the combined pass read confidently keeps its combined text.
safety_fixes.confidence_gate: A region the combined pass read at >= 0.90 mean confidence is not rerouted at all. Regions that regressed had been read at 0.95-0.96.
safety_fixes.hard_time_budget: _run_tesseract takes an explicit timeout; every additional pass is capped at min(engine ceiling, remaining routing budget), and a timeout keeps the combined reading with reason greek-pass-timed-out.
safety_fixes.shared_budget: Greek routing and the small-type pass share one _Budget, so enabling both cannot double a page's worst case.

cgpg_holdout_full.note: Full holdout, not a slice. Still not the paper's 30-page test split; no comparison with its headline accuracy is made.

small_type_latin.detection: contiguous lines with line pitch <= 0.92x block median, Latin-dominant, >= 3 lines, >= 40 Latin letters; geometric and script-based only, never lexical

missed.gate: at least 3 of 4 named words fixed

why_default_off: Calibrated on a single real scanned page; pitch thresholds are not yet evidence about scanned books in general.
Footnote umlaut errors reach 3/16 against a <= 2/16 target.
Two of the four known failing words are repaired (Zwölfzahl, gegründete) against a >= 3/4 target; diesbezüglichen and Stählin still fail.

bookmark_recalibration.change: Added a structural-consensus route to automatic confirmation. The numeric gate is unchanged; the new route requires an exactly agreeing printed-page mapping corroborated by >= 4 independent anchors and holds every placement-safety condition at full strength, while allowing total/title/word-confidence shortfalls to be outweighed down to hard floors.
bookmark_recalibration.corpus: real 160-page scanned volume, frozen OCR evidence, not committed

valid_candidate_auto_confirm_rate.note: Below target. The four remaining are honest refusals: 216-point margin, 0.04 TOC word confidence, and two totals below the consensus floor.

bookmark_recalibration.toc_printed_pages_parsed: 24/24 rows (26 TOC lines, 2 wrapped continuations merged)
bookmark_recalibration.outline_readback: qpdf --json outlines matches the confirmed set exactly (9 entries)

correction_0_4.defect: Rule 0.3 read MappingSegment.anchor_count as agreement. That is the count of every anchor the dynamic program placed in the run, including ones whose own observed offset disagrees with the segment offset -- the solver pays anchor_mismatch_penalty to keep them so a stray heading cannot fork the mapping. It also let an entry count itself.
correction_0_4.fix: MappingSegment now carries member_count (diagnostic only), exact_anchor_count, disagreeing_anchor_count and the ordinals of the exact anchors. The gate reads independent exact anchors: exact anchors minus the entry being judged.

status_counts_unchanged.note: Unchanged because 11 independent exact anchors still clear the threshold of 4. The evidence behind the decision is now honest; the decision happens to be the same.

correction_0_4.outline_readback: qpdf outline identical to the confirmed set (9 entries)
correction_0_4.schema: mpdf-bookmark-generation-report-0.1 segment object now requires member_count, exact_anchor_count, disagreeing_anchor_count

checkpoint_binding.note: SidecarOcrConfig::passes is passed as --routing/--small-type-latin and hashed into job_fingerprint, so toggling either invalidates existing OCR checkpoints.

rapidocr_argv_contract.defect: The Rust runner spells out --routing and --small-type-latin for every sidecar it launches. rapidocr_sidecar.py did not declare them, so argparse would exit 2 before reading stdin and the runner would report a still-reachable CLI path as an unavailable provider.
rapidocr_argv_contract.test: test_every_sidecar_parses_the_runners_argv starts each sidecar as a real process with the exact argv the runner builds and asserts it does not exit 2; a negative control proves argparse really does exit 2 on an unknown option there.
